artifacts.synopsis: RE Mark Grasso and others challenged Philadelphia Presbytery's licensure and ordination of Jason Hsu, who held a stated difference concerning women deacons but affirmed willingness to follow the BCO. The SJC denied the complaint and affirmed Presbytery's actions; a dissent was recorded.
